title: Chapter 68 Encountering Horse Bandits On The Road
content:
Chapter 68 Encountering Horse Bandits On The Road

"Alert." Wang Shuo said immediately.

"Let's hide in the woods." Wang Shuo thought for a while and then added.

Before Wang Shuo and the others could hide in the woods, a large group of horse bandits surrounded them.

"Woo, woo..."

Wang Shuo frowned, apparently he was prepared.

There were about forty or fifty people in this group of horse bandits, headed by a man with a beard.

[McGinnon (leader of the horse bandits in Pegasus Village)]

[Level: Level 22]

[Attack power: 170]

[Defense: 40]

[Health value: 2600]

Wang Shuo checked the attributes of this boss.

This sight made Wang Shuo frown even deeper.

The level of other gangsters is generally around level 18, and they also have an absolute advantage in terms of level and number of people.

However, looking at their equipment, Wang Shuo breathed a sigh of relief.

Seeing that Wang Shuo was in a daze, Dongfang Ling pretended to be nervous, pulled Wang Shuo's sleeves, and whispered: "You don't want to surrender, do you?"

Before Wang Shuo could speak, McGinn laughed loudly and said loudly: "Hey, there is also a little girl who just happened to be captured and made the wife of the boss."

The surrounding horse bandits immediately started to boo, and rode in a circle around Wang Shuo and others.

Wang Shuo glanced at Ayub and saw that there was no fear on his face, and he felt reassured.

There are only dozens of horse bandits here, but they can't defeat their swift scout team.

Even if you can't fight, you can definitely escape by running.

But will Wang Shuo run away?

Obviously not.

"Mount your horse and prepare for battle."

Wang Shuo gave an order, and the cavalry squad immediately summoned their horses, took out their weapons, and prepared to face the enemy.

The horse bandit couldn't help but be a little surprised when he saw this!

At this moment in the past, the other party had already knelt down and kowtowed to beg for mercy. Could it be that this time he encountered a tough fight.

"Don't you have a mount?" Seeing Dongfang Ling standing there without moving, Wang Shuo asked anxiously.

Dongfang Ling was just about to say, how could she not have it, but she hesitated for a moment, then changed her words: "I didn't have it."

She has countless ways to deal with the current situation.

But at this time, she just wanted to test Wang Shuo to see if he would give up on his "dagger" at the critical moment.

Just when Dongfang Ling was thinking wildly, Wang Shuo pulled her onto the horse.

"charge."

Ayub immediately rushed forward and opened a passage for Wang Shuo and others.

When Maginnon saw that the other party dared to break through, he was furious.

"Stop them for me. The men will be killed without mercy, and the women must be captured alive."

After receiving the Blue Dragon Sword, Ayub's combat power soared, and he was also blessed with the Cavalry Medal. Ordinary horse bandits were no match for him.

No one can stop him.

Soon, everyone rushed out of the encirclement.

Dongfang Ling never expected that Wang Shuo would pull her directly onto the horse. At this time, she was lying on the horse, jolting violently, her stomach was churning, and she was in unspeakable pain.

She felt some regret, grabbed Wang Shuo's armor, and said angrily: "Put me down."

The battle was at a critical juncture. Wang Shuo could not stop, but said sternly: "Don't make trouble!"

A few minutes later, Wang Shuo and others left the horse bandits far behind.

"Abu, do we have the strength to charge back?" Wang Shuo asked his favorite general.

At this time, he was a little envious of the opponent's war horses.

"certainly."

After receiving Ayub's affirmative answer, Wang Shuo ordered the horse to turn around and charge in the opposite direction.

Although there are only 10 riders, there is an indomitable momentum.

The two groups clashed again.

The other party was immediately killed and turned upside down.

There is still a big gap between well-trained cavalry and horse bandits who have not changed jobs, both in terms of attributes and team combat.

Ayub also got into a fight with the opponent's leader, Meginon, and the two sides fought fiercely on horseback.

After about ten rounds, McGinnon was knocked off his horse.

Wang Shuo and others immediately organized another charge. The formation of the horse bandits was rushed to pieces. After being defeated, they began to flee in all directions.

The cavalry team immediately pursued the victory and captured several more people.

The war came to an end, and Gong Zheng confiscated their weapons and horse tags.

"Lord, how should we deal with these horse bandits?"

Wang Shuo thought about it for a while. He had to go to Nanshanji during his trip, so it was not convenient to take prisoners.

So he ordered to kill them all.

Even the leader, McGinnon, was killed.

After cleaning the battlefield, Wang Shuo counted the seized materials.

[Horse Card +34, Soul Crystal +1, Energy Crystal +65]

There were also some other ordinary equipment, which Wang Shuo did not waste. He planned to take them to Nanshanji and see if they could be exchanged for money.

While Wang Shuo was counting the supplies, Dongfang Ling kept vomiting next to him, almost vomiting out everything he ate yesterday.

While vomiting, he also cursed Wang Shuo.

"You damn bastard, I have to make you look good."

Wang Shuo came over and said with a smile: "Dongfang Ling, you can't stand this anymore? I advise you to find a place to hide! If you are caught in this chaotic situation and become the wife of a stronghold, let's see what you do! "

"I want you to take care of it." Dongfang Ling pouted and said angrily.

"Have you finished vomiting? We are on our way." Wang Shuo looked at the embarrassed Dongfang Ling and said slowly.

After a while, Dongfang Ling came over and said to Wang Shuo, "You can go now."

"Are you riding alone, or..."

"Give me a horse." Since she said she didn't have a mount, she couldn't take out her own exotic beast mount at this moment.

Continue to head towards Nanshan Market.

Along the way, Wang Shuo saw many villages built by players.

There were several to dozens of people, and even more, there were already hundreds of people.

It surprised Wang Shuo.

In the wild, there were more players, killing monsters to level up.

Wang Shuo also encountered several attacks from wild monsters, but he easily killed them and became Wang Shuo's reserve food.

Ten miles away from Nanshan Market, Wang Shuo stopped.

It was about to get dark, and Wang Shuo arranged people to set up camp.

Because he didn't know the situation in Nanshan Market, Wang Shuo decided to spend the night here tonight.

The possibility of encountering danger at night is much greater than during the day.

After setting up the tent, he arranged the three brothers Li Jianguo to patrol around.

The level of these three brothers has also been raised to level 9 in the continuous battles, and they can barely stand alone.

Sitting by the fire, Wang Shuo fell into deep thought.

The situation around Watang Mountain is quite complicated.

There are bandits on the mountain, horse bandits from Feima Village in the distance, and countless wild beasts in the wild, all of which are potential threats.

The countless small villages around are facing these major threats. If they are not strong enough, there is only one way to die.

...

Horse bandit camp.

When Wang Shuo killed the horse bandits, several horse bandit minions who escaped also returned to the horse bandit camp.

"Boss, something bad has happened!"

"You are so flustered, what a disgrace!" In the tent, an ugly man was holding a knife in his right hand and cutting the mutton on the plate.

Below him, there was a handsome young man sitting.

The horse bandit minions told the boss who was eating meat about the murder of McGinnon.

"You really don't know how to live or die. Third brother, take some brothers with you and go and capture the man." The big boss said to a strong man sitting opposite the young man.

"Yes, big brother." The strong man stood up with a long axe in his hand, and his voice was like a bell.
